Leading eigenfunctions are nonnegative and Rayleigh quotient comparison gives 0≤λ*−λ_ε≤||K*−K_ε||, without incorrectly claiming positive semidefinite difference. For nonnegative difference kernel Dε, Hε(t)=∫_0^t(r^{−1/2}−r^{−1/2+ε/2})dr=2√t−2t^{(1+ε)/2}/(1+ε); derivative Hε″=.5 t^{−3/2}[(1−ε)t^{ε/2}−1]<0, so the symmetric row sum is maximized at x=1/2, exactly δ(ε)=2√2(1−2^{−ε/2}/(1+ε)). Schur yields ||Dε||≤δ(ε), proving two-sided normalized bound and error modulus for ALL 0<ε<1. Independent high-precision Decimal evaluation at ε=.02: δ=.0746136429069799366 and enclosure 1.3171293297370383<R(.02)<1.3548073724874499 using source certified λ* bounds. Finite script/grid is diagnostic only and not used to prove concavity or infinite-dimensional spectral result.
